# YourPods

> YourPods is a gPodder compatible, privacy-first and self-hosted podcast player for iOS, macOS, and Apple Watch. Sync your subscriptions and listening progress across all your devices using your own Nextcloud server.

## Project Info

- [README](README.md): Main documentation and feature overview
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer guide and contribution rules
- [License](LICENSE): GNU General Public License v3.0

## Core Features

- **Apple Ecosystem**: Optimized for iOS, macOS, watchOS, and CarPlay.
- **Privacy**: No tracking, analytics, or ads. Self-hosted sync.
- **Smart Queue**: Drag-and-drop management.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Provider, Just Audio, Hive/SQLite.
